item.title: AWS with OpenTofu: Auto Scaling Based on CPU Utilization
item.description:
Purpose

In the previous tutorial, we deployed two webservers behind an Application Load Balancer for zero-downtime failover. The ASG maintained exactly 2 instances at all times — no more, no less. But what happens when traffic spikes and your two servers can’t keep up?

In this tutorial, we add an auto scaling policy so that the ASG can dynamically scale out from 2 to 3 webservers when the average CPU utilization crosses a threshold, and scale back in when the load drops. This is the difference between a fixed fleet and an elastic one — AWS automatically adjusts capacity to match demand.
